simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צָרְתָן (H6891) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צָרְתָן (Tsârᵉthân) means Tsarethan , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 4 12.

definitions.full: H6891. Tsarethan צָֽרְתָן proper name, of a location in Jordan valley, near ford , Buhl Geogr. 181 ; exact site known; Josh 3:16 ( Καθιαιρειν , ᵐ5 of L Καριαθιαρειμ ), 1Kin 7:46 ( Σειρα , ᵐ5 of L Σαρθαν ) = צְרֵדָ֫תָה 2Chr 4:17 ( Αναμε [i.e. ἀνὰ μέσον ] σιρδαθαι ; Σα ( ρι ) δαθα ; is Chronicles right?); צָֽרְחַ֫נָה 1Kin 4:12 ( Σεσαθαν , ᵐ5 of L Σαρθαν ) — compare צְרֵרָתָה Judg 7:22 , apparently same place; identity with צְרֵדָה 1Kin 11:26 is usually assumed, but not proven.
